items.title: Ukrainian drones target St Petersburg in attack Russia calls 'unprecedented'
items.description: Residents of Russia's second-largest city were urged to stay indoors for the first time since the war started.

items.title: US and Iran exchange strikes in Gulf in latest test of ceasefire
items.description: The US military strikes Iranian drones and radar sites and Tehran says it has targeted US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain.

items.title: Hegseth attacks Europe over 'invasion' of migrants on its beaches in D-Day speech
items.description: The US defence secretary was speaking in Normandy, 82 years after allied forces launched their operation to liberate Nazi-occupied north-western Europe.

items.title: Funeral held for baby shot dead by Israeli troops in occupied West Bank
items.description: The seven-month-old boy's shrouded body was wrapped in a Palestinian flag and carried by his father to the graveyard.

items.title: Pope begins Spain visit with praise for country's opposition to war and support for migrants
items.description: On the first day of his official seven-day tour of Spain, the Pope praises the country's "active commitment to peace and solidarity among peoples".

items.title: Iran says staff blocked from entering US after players given World Cup visas
items.description: Iranian officials say technical staff have been denied visas, hours after the US said players could enter the country.

items.title: Andreeva wins French Open as Chwalinska fairytale ends
items.description: Teenager Mirra Andreeva fulfils her huge potential with a first Grand Slam title as Polish qualifier Maja Chwalinska is denied a fairytale French Open victory.

items.title: Lebanese general among three soldiers killed in Israeli attack on car
items.description: The Israeli military is investigating the incident in south Lebanon, where it is fighting Hezbollah.

items.title: Rumours and speculation as fans forecast date of Taylor Swift's wedding
items.description: Swifties worldwide are looking for clues about the superstar's nuptials to American football star Travis Kelce.

items.title: Canada bans Texas cattle over flesh-eating screwworm outbreak in US
items.description: The ban came as a second infected calf was identified in Texas, and the US state declaring a state of disaster over the outbreak.

items.title: I wanted to quit Eurovision twice - then won it, says Bangaranga singer Dara
items.description: The Bulgarian singer says her historic victory in Vienna came close to never happening.

items.title: US plans to fight flesh-eating screwworm outbreak with flies and dogs
items.description: The insect, which has been found in America for the first time since 1966, is a growing concern in the southern US.
